scenes.narration_ru: В амбарах лежат сухое сено, древесина, ткань, зерно и масло.

scenes.main_action: Reveal stored hay, wood, cloth, grain sacks and an oil jar.

scenes.main_action: A small ember reaches dry material; flame grows from one precise source.

scenes.narration_ru: Сегодня мы привыкли думать просто: кто-то звонит пожарным, через несколько минут приезжает машина

scenes.narration_ru: с насосом, длинными рукавами, лестницами, защитными костюмами и большим запасом воды.
scenes.visual_description_en: Show pump panel, hose, ladder and protective equipment on the modern vehicle.
scenes.main_action: Show pump panel, hose, ladder and protective equipment on the modern vehicle.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q004: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Но большую часть человеческой истории ничего этого не существовало.
Не было пожарных машин.
Не было гидрантов.
scenes.visual_description_en: Return to the old street: residents have buckets and hand tools.
scenes.main_action: Return to the old street: residents have buckets and hand tools.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q005: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
Не было радиосвязи.
Не было моторных насосов.
Иногда не было даже организованной пожарной службы.
scenes.visual_description_en: Period buckets, rope and manual implements replace communication and motor power.
scenes.main_action: Period buckets, rope and manual implements replace communication and motor power.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q006: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
И всё же города не исчезали после каждого пожара.
Люди снова и снова находили способы бороться с огнём
scenes.visual_description_en: Neighbors assemble beside the well rather than abandoning the town.
scenes.main_action: Neighbors assemble beside the well rather than abandoning the town.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q007: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: ведрами, крюками, лестницами, бочками, колодцами, цепочками людей и довольно жестокими решениями.
scenes.visual_description_en: Reveal wooden buckets, long hooks, a wooden ladder and water barrel in spoken order.
scenes.main_action: Reveal wooden buckets, long hooks, a wooden ladder and water barrel in spoken order.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q008: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Потому что иногда, чтобы спасти город от огня, приходилось разрушить часть самого города.
scenes.visual_description_en: A doomed connecting shed is pulled down to protect the next house.
scenes.main_action: A doomed connecting shed is pulled down to protect the next house.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q009: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Сегодня разберёмся, как именно люди тушили пожары до появления современных пожарных машин
scenes.visual_description_en: Establish the water chain and coordinated response.
scenes.main_action: Establish the water chain and coordinated response.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q010: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: почему вода была не единственным оружием
scenes.visual_description_en: Contrast water with sand and the deliberate removal of fuel.
scenes.main_action: Contrast water with sand and the deliberate removal of fuel.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q011: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: зачем пожарные носили огромные крюки, почему дома могли специально сносить во время пожара
scenes.visual_description_en: Workers engage a long iron hook in a burning roof member.
scenes.main_action: Workers engage a long iron hook in a burning roof member.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q012: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: и как одна ошибка могла превратить обычный огонь в катастрофу для целого города.
scenes.visual_description_en: A small ignition expands through one tightly packed neighborhood.
scenes.main_action: A small ignition expands through one tightly packed neighborhood.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q013: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
Начнём с самой важной проблемы.
Огонь в старом городе распространялся гораздо быстрее, чем кажется современному человеку.
scenes.visual_description_en: Establish narrow streets and touching combustible roofs.
scenes.main_action: Establish narrow streets and touching combustible roofs.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q013: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru: Сегодня между зданиями обычно есть дороги, дворы, противопожарные стены, бетон, кирпич и другие негорючие материалы.
scenes.visual_description_en: Contrast today's wider streets and masonry separation.
scenes.main_action: Contrast today's wider streets and masonry separation.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q014: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
В старом городе всё могло выглядеть совсем иначе.
Дом был деревянным.
Забор был деревянным.
Склад был деревянным.
scenes.visual_description_en: Reveal timber wall, fence, shed and wooden cart as connected fuel.
scenes.main_action: Reveal timber wall, fence, shed and wooden cart as connected fuel.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q015: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
Телега была деревянной.
Лестница была деревянной.
Даже мостовая в некоторых местах могла быть частично деревянной.
scenes.visual_description_en: Move from wooden cart to ladder and timber paving.
scenes.main_action: Move from wooden cart to ladder and timber paving.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q016: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Внутри домов находились дрова, солома, ткани, масло, свечи, уголь и другие материалы, которые прекрасно поддерживали огонь.
scenes.visual_description_en: Show combustible household materials near necessary open flames.
scenes.main_action: Show combustible household materials near necessary open flames.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q017: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Если пламя вырывалось из окна, оно могло быстро перекинуться на крышу соседнего дома.
scenes.visual_description_en: Window flames lick toward the neighboring eaves.
scenes.main_action: Window flames lick toward the neighboring eaves.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q018: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Если ветер был сильным, горящие куски дерева и раскалённые угли улетали дальше по улице.
scenes.visual_description_en: Wind carries glowing embers across the street.
scenes.main_action: Wind carries glowing embers across the street.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q018: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Один горящий дом превращался в три.
Три — в десять.
А через некоторое время горел уже целый квартал.
scenes.visual_description_en: One fire becomes several separate roof fires and then a burning block.
scenes.main_action: One fire becomes several separate roof fires and then a burning block.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q019: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
Поэтому главной задачей старых пожарных было не просто потушить конкретное пламя.
Нужно было остановить распространение пожара.
И вот здесь начинались методы, которые сегодня могут показаться странными.
scenes.visual_description_en: The crew protects the unburned edge instead of staring at the largest flame.
scenes.main_action: The crew protects the unburned edge instead of staring at the largest flame.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q019: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Самым простым инструментом было ведро.
Обычное деревянное или кожаное ведро было важнейшим противопожарным оборудованием на протяжении веков.
scenes.visual_description_en: Rotate attention around a wooden bucket and a stitched leather bucket.
scenes.main_action: Rotate attention around a wooden bucket and a stitched leather bucket.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q020: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
Во многих городах жители обязаны были хранить дома ведра специально на случай пожара.
Иногда местные власти даже устанавливали, сколько ведер должен иметь владелец большого дома, мастерской или склада.
scenes.visual_description_en: A household hangs dedicated fire buckets beside the door.
scenes.main_action: A household hangs dedicated fire buckets beside the door.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q021: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Когда начинался пожар, люди бежали к ближайшему колодцу, реке, каналу или бочке с водой.
scenes.visual_description_en: Neighbors hurry to well and barrel to establish a water supply.
scenes.main_action: Neighbors hurry to well and barrel to establish a water supply.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q022: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
Затем строилась цепочка.
Один человек набирал воду.
scenes.visual_description_en: One worker lowers and retrieves a bucket, then hands it to the next.
scenes.main_action: One worker lowers and retrieves a bucket, then hands it to the next.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q022: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Следующий передавал ведро дальше.
Потом ещё один.
И ещё.
Так ведро проходило через десятки рук, пока не добиралось до огня.
scenes.visual_description_en: Filled buckets pass hand to hand toward the burning house.
scenes.main_action: Filled buckets pass hand to hand toward the burning house.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q022: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Пустые ведра возвращались обратно по другой линии.
Получался человеческий конвейер.
scenes.visual_description_en: A separate foreground line returns empty buckets toward the well.
scenes.main_action: A separate foreground line returns empty buckets toward the well.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q022: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru: Эта система была примитивной, но в небольшом пожаре она могла работать удивительно хорошо.
scenes.visual_description_en: A modest fire shrinks under repeated accurately directed pours.
scenes.main_action: A modest fire shrinks under repeated accurately directed pours.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q022: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Проблема заключалась в количестве воды.
Одно ведро содержало немного.
Огонь большого деревянного дома мог потреблять огромное количество воды каждую минуту.
scenes.visual_description_en: The small volume of a bucket contrasts with a heavily involved building.
scenes.main_action: The small volume of a bucket contrasts with a heavily involved building.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q022: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru: Если людей было мало, если колодец находился далеко или если на улице возникала паника, цепочка быстро ломалась.
scenes.visual_description_en: A gap in the chain and a distant source interrupt water delivery.
scenes.main_action: A gap in the chain and a distant source interrupt water delivery.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q022: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Кроме того, воду нужно было доставлять не только к стене дома.
Нужно было попасть именно туда, где горел огонь.
А это означало, что люди подходили очень близко к пламени.
scenes.visual_description_en: A resident approaches close enough to aim a bucket at the window flame.
scenes.main_action: A resident approaches close enough to aim a bucket at the window flame.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q022: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Они рисковали получить ожоги.
На них падали горящие балки.
Крыша могла рухнуть.
scenes.visual_description_en: Heat and falling fragments force a retreat from the facade.
scenes.main_action: Heat and falling fragments force a retreat from the facade.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q023: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Окно могло внезапно выбросить наружу поток горячего воздуха и дыма.
scenes.visual_description_en: Hot smoke pushes out of an upper opening toward exposed workers.
scenes.main_action: Hot smoke pushes out of an upper opening toward exposed workers.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q023: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Никаких современных защитных костюмов у них не было.
Шерстяная одежда могла немного защищать от искр, но от сильного жара она не спасала.
scenes.visual_description_en: Wool clothing blocks minor sparks but offers little protection from intense heat.
scenes.main_action: Wool clothing blocks minor sparks but offers little protection from intense heat.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q024: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Именно поэтому важнейшим инструментом пожарных была лестница.
scenes.visual_description_en: Two identifiable workers carry a heavy wooden ladder toward the house.
scenes.main_action: Two identifiable workers carry a heavy wooden ladder toward the house.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q025: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Лестницы позволяли подниматься к окнам и крышам.
scenes.visual_description_en: The pair seats the ladder feet and leans it securely against the wall.
scenes.main_action: The pair seats the ladder feet and leans it securely against the wall.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q025: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru: С крыши можно было заливать огонь водой.
scenes.visual_description_en: A climber reaches the eave and pours water while another braces the base.
scenes.main_action: A climber reaches the eave and pours water while another braces the base.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q025: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru: Можно было сбивать горящие части кровли.
scenes.visual_description_en: A roof worker removes a burning loose fragment with a pole.
scenes.main_action: A roof worker removes a burning loose fragment with a pole.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q025: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru: Можно было помогать людям выбраться из верхних этажей.
scenes.visual_description_en: A resident is helped down from the upper window.
scenes.main_action: A resident is helped down from the upper window.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q025: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Но лестница сама по себе создавала новый риск.
Она была тяжелой.
Обычно деревянной.
Её несли несколько человек.
А если дом уже горел слишком сильно, ставить лестницу к стене было опасно.
Стена могла обрушиться прямо на людей.
scenes.visual_description_en: The heavy ladder needs a team; the unstable burning wall threatens them.
scenes.main_action: The heavy ladder needs a team; the unstable burning wall threatens them.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q025: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Поэтому опытные пожарные учились смотреть не только на пламя.
Они наблюдали за конструкцией дома.
scenes.visual_description_en: The foreman watches the bowed wall and sagging roof rather than only the flame.
scenes.main_action: The foreman watches the bowed wall and sagging roof rather than only the flame.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q026: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru: Если стена начинала выгибаться, если крыша проседала, если балки трещали, нужно было отходить.
scenes.visual_description_en: A beam sags; workers withdraw together before a controlled structural fall.
scenes.main_action: A beam sags; workers withdraw together before a controlled structural fall.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q026: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. Continue operation time and object states from previous shot.

scenes.narration_ru:
Но в шуме большого пожара заметить это было трудно.
Крики.
scenes.visual_description_en: Smoke, alarm, moving cart and neighbors compete for the narrow street.
scenes.main_action: Smoke, alarm, moving cart and neighbors compete for the narrow street.
scenes.continuity_note: Sequence Q027: same identifiable teal water worker, red tool worker, ochre coordinator and blue pump operator; preserve equipment placement, source, travel direction, fire state and lighting. New location/action established.

scenes.narration_ru:
Колокола.
Треск дерева.
scenes.visual_description_en: The bell swings above the town while the alarm rope is pulled.
